title: Joe Petit and Buddy Petit's upbringing and teacher
summary: Joe Petit was Buddy's stepfather; Buddy was actually named Joseph Crawford and had perfect notes and an unknown teacher.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well, ask him if Joe Petit taught him anything, the Tramon player.

Did Joe Petit taught him anything? Joe Petit. No, he didn't get on it. He was nothing. Ma was fancy. He brought Ma was fancy down there. Ma was playing the country, what he called Buddy. Buddy, I think I didn't beat that old man blowing tramboyle. Buddy said, yeah, that's my daddy. Ma was catching it. He said, you can beat my daddy playing. Ma said, yes, sir. He said, come up here and play. Ma got up there and he played. Buddy for the ball. He said, you want to go back to the city? He said, yes, sir. He said, all right, go see your people. I'll take him back when we leave the boys. And he went, brought him down there. And he played with his kid old Buddy got thrown, he came up to lose his weight, then he left for him to Alexandra. That old Ma was special and a good trombone player.
But who did Buddy learn from?

Who did Buddy learn from? Who liked Buddy? I didn't know who learned Buddy. You know, that wasn't Buddy's daddy. No, stepdaddy. They say he raised Buddy from a little baby. Buddy know what he, but we always thought he was his daddy, but he wasn't. So he raised Buddy, so Buddy went by his name. Buddy was Teeba. Buddy told us his name, you know. Crawford.

Huh? Buddy was named Joseph Crawford. Something like that. Yeah. They just went by the little old man petite because he raised it. And then Buddy was Teeba, you know. Both of them, all of them, Teeba. Buddy must have had a good teacher. See, Buddy must have had a good teacher. He must have had, and Buddy was sighted. Make his notes clear, everything. Perfect. I tell him that Buddy was in a tunnel like that, boy. I mean, Luke Armstrong used to be Buddy. Luke was down there at Teeb Spooner, you know, came down. I don't know.
